newsitem.title: USA: Rubin - U.S. can have higher growth in future - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Rubin - U.S. can have higher growth in future - RFTV.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Tuesday the United States can have higher economic growth in the future and that currently he saw no signs of inflation re-igniting.
"I think we can have higher growth in the future," Rubin told Reuters Financial Television in an interview from the Democratic convention in Chicago.
While vigilance on inflation is always necessary, "I don't see any signs right now of a re-ignition of inflation," he also said during the interview.
The Clinton administration, in a second term, would continue its policy that a strong dollar is good for the United States, Rubin said.

"We always had the view, and I think correctly, that a strong dollar was in the best interest of this country," he said. That has been the policy during the first term of the Clinton administration "and it will be our policy going forward in the years ahead," Rubin said.
The Treasury is not currently considering changing the mix of its debt issue maturities, Rubin said.

"I don't think ... it's very likely that we would change our mix in any way," he said. "I don't think that we'll be taking another look at our mix, I think we've got it about right," Rubin added, in response to a question.
